description: This file defines the SugarCacheMemcache class, which implements caching functionality using Memcache for the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM platform. It extends the abstract SugarCacheAbstract class and manages Memcache connection, cache set, get, delete, and flush operations, with configuration options for host, port, and compression.

classes.name: SugarCacheMemcache
classes.description: Implements caching using Memcache backend for SugarCRM/SuiteCRM, managing connection and cache operations.

methods.name: useBackend
methods.description: Determines if the Memcache backend can be used based on environment and configuration.

methods.name: _getMemcacheObject
methods.description: Initializes and returns the Memcache object, configuring host, port, and compression based on settings.

methods.name: _setExternal
methods.description: Sets a cache entry in Memcache.

methods.name: _getExternal
methods.description: Retrieves a cache entry from Memcache.

methods.name: _clearExternal
methods.description: Deletes a cache entry from Memcache.

methods.name: _resetExternal
methods.description: Clears all cache entries from Memcache.
